studies.label: Ichimoku Cloud (9, 26, 52)
studies.gloss: the conversion line is the midpoint of the last 9 bars and the base line of the last 26; span A averages the two and span B is the 52-bar midpoint, both carried forward 25 bars (TradingView's displacement 26, plotted one bar short of it); the lagging close is the close 25 bars back
